latest_release.body:
## Docker Image

**Version:** 0.8.26
**Environment:** production
**Git Commit:** b0023aeb
**Build Date:** 20261112

📖 **[View Project Documentation](https://github.com/sgoudelis/ground-station)**

### Commits in this release:
- b0023aeb chore(version): bump to v0.8.26
- 73737bf1 test(setup-wizard): expect census opt-in switch to be enabled
- 7b45a747 feat(feedback): improve census opt-in settings card
- bfc774a6 feat(feedback): add localized settings translations
- 7ba3acbf fix(feedback): derive reporting environment from deployment config
- 26236dfe feat(navigation): group system pages and route maintenance tabs
- 78fca5b0 feat(navigation): group system pages and route maintenance tabs
- 387f45ac Pin browser tests to supported Ubuntu runner
- b6d23af2 Add opt-in installation census with disclosed country inference
- 555be8d4 i18n: complete and refine Chinese translations
- 272c1b64 fix(scheduler): preserve started observations during regeneration

### Pull the Docker image:

**For AMD64 systems:**
```bash
docker pull --platform linux/amd64 ghcr.io/sgoudelis/ground-station:0.8.26
```

**For ARM64 systems (Raspberry Pi, etc):**
```bash
docker pull --platform linux/arm64 ghcr.io/sgoudelis/ground-station:0.8.26
```

Or pull architecture-specific tags directly:
```bash
# AMD64
docker pull ghcr.io/sgoudelis/ground-station:0.8.26-amd64

# ARM64
docker pull ghcr.io/sgoudelis/ground-station:0.8.26-arm64
```

### Run the container:

**Option 1: With SoapySDR Remote Server Discovery (Recommended)**

Uses host networking to enable mDNS discovery of SoapySDR remote servers:

```bash
# AMD64
docker run -d \
  --platform linux/amd64 \
  --network host \
  -e GS_HTTP_PORT=7000 \
  --name ground-station \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  --device=/dev/bus/usb \
  --privileged \
  -v /path/to/data:/app/backend/data \
  ghcr.io/sgoudelis/ground-station:0.8.26
```

```bash
# ARM64 (Raspberry Pi, etc)
docker run -d \
  --platform linux/arm64 \
  --network host \
  -e GS_HTTP_PORT=7000 \
  --name ground-station \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  -v /dev:/dev \
  --privileged \
  -v /path/to/data:/app/backend/data \
  ghcr.io/sgoudelis/ground-station:0.8.26
```

**Option 2: Standard Bridge Mode (No SoapySDR Remote Discovery)**

Uses standard bridge networking with port mapping:

```bash
# AMD64
docker run -d \
  --platform linux/amd64 \
  -p 7000:7000 \
  --name ground-station \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  --device=/dev/bus/usb \
  --privileged \
  -v /path/to/data:/app/backend/data \
  ghcr.io/sgoudelis/ground-station:0.8.26
```

```bash
# ARM64 (Raspberry Pi, etc)
docker run -d \
  --platform linux/arm64 \
  -p 7000:7000 \
  --name ground-station \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  -v /dev:/dev \
  --privileged \
  -v /path/to/data:/app/backend/data \
  ghcr.io/sgoudelis/ground-station:0.8.26
```

> **Port selection:** In host-network mode, change `GS_HTTP_PORT=7000` to your desired HTTP port, such as `GS_HTTP_PORT=8080`. Docker ignores `-p` in this mode. In bridge mode, change the host side of `-p 7000:7000`, such as `-p 8080:7000`; keep the container side at 7000. The backend remains on `127.0.0.1:7001` inside the container.

> **Note:** Replace `/path/to/data` with your desired data directory path. For ARM64, using `-v /dev:/dev` ensures all USB devices are accessible.

After starting the container, access the web interface at `http://<YOUR_HOST>:<HTTP_PORT>` (7000 by default).

> **First startup note:** On first run, it can take up to ~30 seconds after container startup for the frontend to become available.
>
> You can watch startup progress with:
> ```bash
> docker logs -f --tail=100 ground-station
> ```

### Upgrading an existing container:
```bash
# Stop and remove the existing container
docker stop ground-station
docker rm ground-station

# Pull the new version
docker pull ghcr.io/sgoudelis/ground-station:0.8.26

# Run the container again (use the appropriate command above for your architecture and retain your HTTP port choice)
```
